잠언 17:1.content: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.

잠언 17:2.content: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

잠언 17:3.content: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the Lord trieth the hearts.

잠언 17:4.content: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.

잠언 17:5.content: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.

잠언 17:6.content: Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

잠언 17:7.content: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.

잠언 17:8.content: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

잠언 17:9.content: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.

잠언 17:10.content: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.

잠언 17:11.content: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

잠언 17:12.content: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

잠언 17:13.content: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

잠언 17:14.content: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

잠언 17:15.content: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the Lord.

잠언 17:16.content: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?

잠언 17:17.content: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

잠언 17:18.content: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.

잠언 17:19.content: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

잠언 17:20.content: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

잠언 17:21.content: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.

잠언 17:22.content: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

잠언 17:23.content: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

잠언 17:24.content: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

잠언 17:25.content: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.

잠언 17:26.content: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.

잠언 17:27.content: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

잠언 17:28.content: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
